import json,os,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
from orbitiq import replay
from orbitiq.storage import get_snapshot,validate_snapshot
from orbitiq.maintenance.recovery import fingerprint

root=Path('/tmp/orbitiq-phase101/genuine');root.mkdir(mode=0o700)
db=Path('/workspace/OrbitIQ/data/orbitiq.sqlite3')
initial=fingerprint(db); initial_sha=replay.digest(db.read_bytes())
items=[get_snapshot(db,i) for i in (1,2)]
for item in items:validate_snapshot(item)
refs=[{'snapshot_id':s['id'],**{k:s[k] for k in ('catalog_id','orbital_epoch','retrieved_at','response_sha256')}} for s in items]
results=[]
for name,mode in [('snapshot','snapshot'),('position','position'),('ground-track','ground-track'),('comparison','comparison'),('max-track','ground-track')]:
 d={'schema_version':1,'mode':mode,'source':refs[0],'frame':'TEME'}
 if mode!='snapshot':d['at']=refs[0]['orbital_epoch']
 if mode=='comparison':d.update(comparison_source=refs[1],frame='ITRS',category='all')
 if mode=='ground-track':d.update(frame='ITRS',track={'start':d['at'],'duration_minutes':60 if name=='max-track' else 2,'step_seconds':10 if name=='max-track' else 60,'selected_index':0})
 p=root/(name+'-definition.json');p.write_bytes(replay.encoded(d))
 directory=root/name
 command=[sys.executable,'-m','orbitiq.maintenance.replay','capture','--definition',str(p),'--directory',str(directory)]
 proc=subprocess.run(command,env={**os.environ,'ORBITIQ_DATABASE_PATH':str(db)},capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=90)
 assert proc.returncode==0,proc.stdout+proc.stderr
 capture=json.loads(proc.stdout)
 hashes={p.name:replay.digest(p.read_bytes()) for p in directory.iterdir()}
 repeated=[]
 for i in range(3):
  command=[sys.executable,'scripts/verify_replay_offline.py','--directory',str(directory),'--expected-manifest-sha256',capture['manifest_sha256']]
  proc=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=90)
  assert proc.returncode==0,proc.stdout+proc.stderr
  (root/(name+f'-replay-{i}.json')).write_text(proc.stdout)
  result=json.loads(proc.stdout)
  assert result['status']==('verified_source_only' if mode=='snapshot' else 'matched')
  assert result['numerical_outcome']==('not_applicable_source_only' if mode=='snapshot' else 'exact_output_reproduction')
  assert result['offline_audit']['attempts']=={'network':0,'database':0}
  repeated.append(result)
 assert len({r['actual_projection_sha256'] for r in repeated})==1
 assert hashes=={p.name:replay.digest(p.read_bytes()) for p in directory.iterdir()}
 results.append({'mode':name,'capture':capture,'repeated_replays':repeated,'bundle_unchanged':True,'members_sha256':hashes})
assert initial==fingerprint(db) and initial_sha==replay.digest(db.read_bytes())
(root/'evidence.json').write_bytes(replay.encoded({'database_unchanged':True,'database_sha256':initial_sha,'snapshots':refs,'results':results}))
print(json.dumps([{'mode':r['mode'],'repeats':len(r['repeated_replays']),'outcome':r['repeated_replays'][0]['numerical_outcome'],'numeric_values_checked':r['repeated_replays'][0]['numeric_values_checked']} for r in results],indent=2))
executed_supporting_harnesses.run_browsers_final.py:
import json,os,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
from orbitiq.database import copy_database
from orbitiq.maintenance.recovery import fingerprint

root=Path('/tmp/orbitiq-phase101/browser-final');root.mkdir(mode=0o755)
root.chmod(0o755)
import shutil
code=root/'orbitiq-source'
shutil.copytree('/workspace/OrbitIQ/backend/orbitiq',code,ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('__pycache__','*.pyc'))
for entry in [code,*code.rglob('*')]:
 entry.chmod(0o555 if entry.is_dir() else 0o444)
source=Path('/workspace/OrbitIQ/data/orbitiq.sqlite3')
copy_database(source, root/'archive.sqlite3')
(root/'archive.sqlite3').chmod(0o444)
assert fingerprint(source)==fingerprint(root/'archive.sqlite3')
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if k not in ('DOCKER_HOST','DOCKER_CONTEXT','DOCKER_TLS','DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY','DOCKER_CERT_PATH')}
commands=[]
def docker(args,expect=True):
 p=subprocess.run(['docker','--host=unix:///var/run/docker.sock',*args],env=env,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=120)
 commands.append({'argv':['docker',*args],'exit_code':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout,'stderr':p.stderr})
 if expect and p.returncode:raise RuntimeError(p.stdout+p.stderr)
 return p
network='orbitiq-phase101'
api='orbitiq-phase101-api';web='orbitiq-phase101-web'
created=[]
try:
 assert docker(['container','inspect',api],False).returncode!=0
 assert docker(['container','inspect',web],False).returncode!=0
 docker(['network','create','--internal',network]);created.append(('network',network))
 docker(['run','--detach','--name',api,'--network',network,'--network-alias','api',
         '--mount',f'type=bind,src={code},dst=/app/backend/orbitiq,readonly',
         '--mount',f'type=bind,src={root},dst=/data,readonly',
         '-e','ORBITIQ_ENVIRONMENT=development','-e','ORBITIQ_DATABASE_PATH=/data/archive.sqlite3',
         'orbitiq-api:phase9-local']);created.append(('container',api))
 docker(['run','--detach','--name',web,'--network',network,'orbitiq-web:phase9-local']);created.append(('container',web))
 for i in range(20):
  p=docker(['exec',web,'wget','-qO-','--timeout=3','-Y','off','http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/health'],False)
  if p.returncode==0:break
  time.sleep(0.3)
 assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr
 for engine in ('chromium','firefox','webkit'):
  for kind,script,args in [
    ('reports','verify_report_browser.py',['--output-directory',str(root/'exports'),*(['--maximum-track'] if engine=='chromium' else [])]),
    ('critical','verify_browser_critical.py',['--catalog','25544','--output',str(root/(engine+'-critical.json'))])]:
   args=['run','--rm','--network','container:'+web,
         '--mount','type=bind,src=/workspace/OrbitIQ/scripts,dst=/checks,readonly',
         '--mount',f'type=bind,src={root},dst={root}',
         'orbitiq-browser:phase81','python','/checks/'+script,
         '--base-url','http://127.0.0.1:8080','--engine',engine,'--first','1','--second','2',*args]
   p=docker(args)
   (root/(engine+'-'+kind+'.log')).write_text(p.stdout+p.stderr)
 assert fingerprint(source)==fingerprint(root/'archive.sqlite3')
finally:
 for kind,name in created:
  if kind=='container':
   p=docker(['logs',name],False)
   (root/(name+'-container.log')).write_text(p.stdout+p.stderr)
 for kind,name in reversed(created):
  docker(['rm','--force',name] if kind=='container' else ['network','rm',name],False)
 (root/'commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(commands,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Browser report/critical flows completed in three engines; isolated internal network removed')
